# IonFamilies

[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/stanstrup/IonFamilies/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/stanstrup/IonFamilies/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
[![pkgdown](https://github.com/stanstrup/IonFamilies/actions/workflows/pkgdown.yaml/badge.svg)](https://stanstrup.github.io/IonFamilies/)

Isotope and adduct annotation of LC-MS feature groups.

One compound gives many LC-MS features: its quasi-molecular ion, other
adducts, in-source fragments and the isotopes of all of these, its *ion
family*.
[`groupFeatures()`](https://rdrr.io/pkg/MsFeatures/man/groupFeatures.html)
from [MsFeatures](https://github.com/RforMassSpectrometry/MsFeatures)
and [xcms](https://github.com/sneumann/xcms) groups features that come
from the same compound. **IonFamilies** annotates the ion family within
each group:

- [`annotateIsotopes()`](https://stanstrup.github.io/IonFamilies/reference/annotateIsotopes.md)
  finds isotope patterns with
  [`MetaboCoreUtils::isotopologues()`](https://rdrr.io/pkg/MetaboCoreUtils/man/isotopologues.html).
- [`annotateAdducts()`](https://stanstrup.github.io/IonFamilies/reference/annotateAdducts.md)
  finds adducts and fragments by neutral-mass voting with a rule list
  (by default from [commonMZ](https://github.com/stanstrup/commonMZ)).
  All supported hypotheses are kept and ranked, because the annotations
  are hints and a missed true annotation is worse than a coincidental
  one.

Results go into
[`featureDefinitions()`](https://rdrr.io/pkg/xcms/man/XCMSnExp-class.html)
of the `XcmsExperiment` in CAMERA’s column format (`pcgroup`,
`isotopes`, `adduct`). All hypotheses are kept in the list column
`adduct_hints`
([`adductHints()`](https://stanstrup.github.io/IonFamilies/reference/adductHints.md)),
and the parameters in `metadata(x)$IonFamilies`.

``` r

library(xcms)
library(MsFeatures)
library(IonFamilies)

x <- groupFeatures(x, SimilarRtimeParam(diffRt = 3))
x <- groupFeatures(x, AbundanceSimilarityParam(threshold = 0.7, transform = log2))
x <- annotateIsotopes(x, IsotopologueParam(ppm = 10))
x <- annotateAdducts(x, AdductVoteParam(polarity = "positive", nBest = 3))
featureDefinitions(x)[, c("feature_group", "pcgroup", "isotopes", "adduct")]
adductHints(x)
```

## Installation

``` r

remotes::install_github("stanstrup/IonFamilies")
```

## Status

Early development (0.99.x, the Bioconductor pre-release numbering).
Documentation: <https://stanstrup.github.io/IonFamilies>. The package
follows the
[RforMassSpectrometry](https://www.rformassspectrometry.org/) and
Bioconductor conventions so that it could be contributed there later.

## Development notes

- Commit messages follow [Conventional
  Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat:`, `fix:`,
  `docs:`, `test:`, `refactor:`, `style:`, `build:`, `ci:`).
- Parts of the code were written with the help of an AI assistant
  (Claude, Anthropic) and reviewed by the maintainer. This is disclosed
  as the RforMassSpectrometry contribution guidelines ask.
- `data/adductRules.rda` is generated by
  `inst/scripts/make-adductRules.R`.
- Releases are made by semantic-release from the commit messages (GitHub
  Actions, `.github/workflows/release.yaml`); versions stay in 0.99.x.
- The pkgdown site is built and deployed to the `gh-pages` branch by
  `.github/workflows/pkgdown.yaml`.

# Package index

## Annotating an XcmsExperiment or plain vectors

Isotope and adduct annotation within feature groups, and access to the
stored results.

- [`annotateIsotopes()`](https://stanstrup.github.io/IonFamilies/reference/annotateIsotopes.md)
  : Annotate isotopes within feature groups
- [`annotateAdducts()`](https://stanstrup.github.io/IonFamilies/reference/annotateAdducts.md)
  : Annotate adducts and fragments within feature groups
- [`adductHints()`](https://stanstrup.github.io/IonFamilies/reference/adductHints.md)
  : All adduct hypotheses of an annotated object
- [`formatAdducts()`](https://stanstrup.github.io/IonFamilies/reference/formatAdducts.md)
  : Write adduct hypotheses as CAMERA-style text
- [`bestHypotheses()`](https://stanstrup.github.io/IonFamilies/reference/bestHypotheses.md)
  : Reduce adduct hypotheses to one per feature
- [`isIsotopologue()`](https://stanstrup.github.io/IonFamilies/reference/isIsotopologue.md)
  : Is an isotope label a heavy isotopologue?

## Parameters

- [`IsotopologueParam()`](https://stanstrup.github.io/IonFamilies/reference/IsotopologueParam.md)
  [`show(`*`<IsotopologueParam>`*`)`](https://stanstrup.github.io/IonFamilies/reference/IsotopologueParam.md)
  : Parameters for isotope annotation
- [`AdductVoteParam()`](https://stanstrup.github.io/IonFamilies/reference/AdductVoteParam.md)
  [`show(`*`<AdductVoteParam>`*`)`](https://stanstrup.github.io/IonFamilies/reference/AdductVoteParam.md)
  : Parameters for adduct and fragment annotation

## Rules

- [`adductRules`](https://stanstrup.github.io/IonFamilies/reference/adductRules.md)
  [`defaultAdductRules()`](https://stanstrup.github.io/IonFamilies/reference/adductRules.md)
  : Default adduct and fragment rules

## Low-level functions

The building blocks of the adduct annotation, exported for teaching and
testing.

- [`impliedMasses()`](https://stanstrup.github.io/IonFamilies/reference/impliedMasses.md)
  : Neutral masses implied by m/z values and rules
- [`neutralMassVote()`](https://stanstrup.github.io/IonFamilies/reference/neutralMassVote.md)
  : Neutral-mass voting within one feature group

## Package

- [`IonFamilies`](https://stanstrup.github.io/IonFamilies/reference/IonFamilies-package.md)
  [`IonFamilies-package`](https://stanstrup.github.io/IonFamilies/reference/IonFamilies-package.md)
  : IonFamilies: isotope and adduct annotation of LC-MS feature groups
